Liza is a multi-agent task execution system that uses a YAML-based
"blackboard" pattern with file locking for state management, git worktrees
for task isolation, and agent supervisors with restart logic.
Usage:
liza [command]
Available Commands:
add-human-note Record bounded operator input for an existing task or all tasks
add-task Add a new task to the state
add-tasks Add multiple tasks in batch from a JSON file
admission-limit Cap how many heavy canonical commands run at once
admit Run a local command inside the admission-limit slots it matches
agent Run agent supervisor loop
amend-plan Review a bounded correction without retiring a merged plan's provider identity
analyze Run circuit breaker response analysis
apply-dependency-repair Apply one stored dependency repair atomically
archive-acceptance-receipts Move terminal tasks' acceptance receipts out of live state into the archive
archive-terminal-tasks Enable immutable terminal task archival and drain the backlog
assess-blocked Record orchestrator assessment of a BLOCKED task
assess-hypothesis-exhausted Record orchestrator assessment of a hypothesis-exhausted task
await-resubmission Block until a doer resubmits after a rejection
await-verdict Block until a review verdict arrives for a submitted task
cancel-task Cancel a task (transition to ABANDONED)
check-commit-allowed Decide whether a commit is allowed in a task worktree (pre-commit hook backend)
claim-task Claim a task for a doer agent
cleanup Remove Liza runtime state and task worktrees
clear-agent-degraded Clear degraded health for an agent
clear-stale-review-claims Clear expired review leases
completion Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
config Read and update supported runtime configuration
defer-provider-dependency Move an unstarted plan's writer-order wait to the outputs it generates
deferred-validation Operate the deferred-validation batch and its operator rulings
delete Delete agents or tasks from the state database
get Query and get state data
get-tasks Query tasks with optional field projection
handoff Initiate context-exhaustion handoff for a claimed task
help Help about any command
init Initialize a new Liza workspace or enable pairing
launch Launch grouped Liza workflows
mark-agent-degraded Mark an agent as degraded for role-capacity health
mark-blocked Mark a task as BLOCKED due to unresolvable blocker
migrate Normalize legacy state.yaml fields
narrow-inherited-dependencies Narrow generated children to selected upstream outputs
pause Pause the Liza system
plan-check Record the orchestrator's disposition of a merged plan before its children exist
proceed Execute a manual inter-pair transition on a task
providers Inspect the provider catalog
provision Record an operator-produced runtime input instance
reaffirm-proof Record an authorized decision that an approved proof still holds against changed content
reconcile-merged Mark an externally merged integration failure as merged
reconcile-verdict Record an authorized orchestrator's decision on quarantined verdict evidence
record-rejection-rca Record a classified rejection RCA on a task held by the rejection-RCA gate
recover-agent Recover a crashed agent (release claims, remove worktree, delete agent)
recover-integration Retire a premature empty-cohort integration analysis with preserved evidence
recover-task Recover a task while preserving recoverable work by default
release-blocked-chain Permit one more replacement of a BLOCKED task at the blocked-recovery cap, without pausing the run
release-claim Manually release claims on a task
repair-acceptance-commits Restore acceptance evidence orphaned by an integration-branch rewrite
repair-agent-pool Start agents for claimable work not covered by idle agents
repair-arch-ref Set the empty arch_ref of a task nobody has started
repair-superseded-dependencies Repair illegal dependencies on one superseded task
replace-task Atomically replace a task and retarget its consumers
replan Re-invoke planner after amending a plan file
reserve-provider Hold an unstarted writer until every child a provider generates merges
resume Resume the Liza system or acknowledge an active HALT response
resume-rejection-rca Close a recorded rejection-RCA gate with an authorized recovery disposition
retarget-dependency Retarget one non-terminal task dependency edge
run-live Run a local live command with the task's reusable runtime inputs
set-discovery-disposition Set the disposition of a discovered item
set-task-output Set output entries for downstream task generation
setup One-time global setup of Liza contracts, skills, and support docs
sprint-checkpoint Create a checkpoint for the sprint
start Start the Liza system from STOPPED mode
status Show system and task status at a glance
stop Stop the Liza system
submit-for-review Submit a task for review
submit-verdict Submit a review verdict
supersede-task Mark a task as SUPERSEDED, optionally by replacement tasks
tool-result Budget tool results and retrieve sanitized artifacts
toolchain Install and configure optional Liza support tools
tui Interactive TUI dashboard for monitoring Liza
unblock-task Restore a repaired BLOCKED task to its initial or executing state
update-review-commit Update review boundary to current worktree HEAD after external rebase
update-sprint-metrics Recompute sprint metrics from current state
usage Report provider token usage by task outcome
use-system-prompt Deliver the agent contracts in the CLI system prompt instead of forced reads (opt-in)
validate Validate state.yaml against schema rules
validate-payload Check a command's payload structurally before invoking it
version Print version information
write-checkpoint Write pre-execution checkpoint before submitting for review
wt-create Create a worktree for a claimed task
wt-delete Delete a worktree for a completed/abandoned task
wt-merge Merge an approved task into the integration branch
Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-h, --help help for liza
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza [command] --help" for more information about a command.
